name: scansci-find
description: ScanSci Find plugin for domain-neutral, auditable academic discovery.

interface.shortDescription: Auditable multi-source academic discovery for every discipline.
interface.longDescription: ScanSci Find distributes a domain-neutral academic search skill and MCP entrypoint with source routing, citation chasing, coverage and PRISMA reports, Journal Scout venue evidence, Zotero exports, and ScanSci PDF-ready queues.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ScanSci Find to plan and run an auditable multi-source academic search, report coverage, and prepare references and full-text queues.
